about_short_description.short_description: InQuery is an AI-native claims processing system that helps claims teams focus on helping claimants recover from catastrophe.

product.name: InQuery Intelligent Medical Record Review
product.description: An AI-powered platform that organizes, indexes, and summarizes medical records to assist legal and medical professionals in reviewing claims efficiently.

product.name: Automated Medical Record Indexing & Labeling
product.description: A feature that automatically categorizes and organizes medical documents by type, date, and relevance to streamline document management.

product.name: Automated Medical Record Summarization
product.description: Generates concise, case-specific summaries from lengthy medical reports to highlight key medical details relevant to claims.

identifier.value: Automated ICD Code & Case Fact Extraction

product.name: Automated ICD Code & Case Fact Extraction
product.description: Automatically identifies and extracts diagnostic codes and critical case facts from medical records to reduce manual data entry errors.

product.name: Automated Downloads & Data Export
product.description: Streamlines the retrieval and export of medical documents and extracted data to reduce manual file management tasks.
